title: Input form
description: A message composer pinned to the bottom of the page. Its menu opens upward, with a submenu and a search inside.
iconsNote: The icons in this form use the default Hover state, so any System Outline or System Solid icon will fit. Stick with the default animation, as In, Morph and Loop states don’t work well here.
